summary: Synchrony Card Funding, LLC and Synchrony Card Issuance Trust filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $750,000,000 offering of SynchronySeries Class A(2026-3) Asset-Backed Notes backed by revolving credit card receivables originated by Synchrony Bank. Terms: 5.13% per annum, monthly interest beginning December 15, 2026, public price 99.98413%, underwriting discount 0.250%, net proceeds 99.73413%; scheduled principal November 2029, legal maturity November 2032; expected issuance November 16, 2026. Enhancement is subordinated SynchronySeries notes plus subordinated transferor amount. Joint bookrunners BofA Securities and Barclays. This is an ordinary ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch credit enhancement sufficiency and early-amortization triggers.
